objective.primary: Estimate transport performance of one fixed structure-blind transcript classifier from K562 development to eligible independent human lung-cancer cell lines using an exactly reconstructed workflow_detection_v1 label.
objective.secondary: Describe cell-line-stratified transport of the fixed workflow-specific five-class transcript measurement phenotype without fitting or selecting a validation-data model.
not_an_objective: validate or rescue the incremental Model D structure hypothesis
reproduce structure features without a matched experimental structure assay
redesign, rerun, retune, rescue, or expand Model D
establish causation, biological truth, clinical utility, or a validated score

target_context.population: eligible independent human lung-cancer cell lines with matched bulk Illumina and bulk ONT direct-RNA biological preparations

transcript_policy.unit: pinned Ensembl 91 transcript accession with version identity retained; unversioned stable ID is only the frozen join key
transcript_policy.universe: the frozen 15999-transcript development cohort in its frozen order
transcript_policy.annotation_requirement: the exact pinned Ensembl 91 transcriptome used in development, or a pre-access exact-identity mapping with gene, chromosome, strand, exon intervals, length, and sequence all equal

technology_policy.reference: pinned Ensembl 91 reference used in development
technology_policy.processed_outputs_allowed: only if metadata prove exact transcript index, quantifier, settings, and complete-row compatibility before values are opened
technology_policy.raw_requantification_allowed: only after size, purpose, processed alternatives, necessity, hashes, and human authorization are recorded

replicate_policy.technical_runs: nested within preparation and never counted as independent support
replicate_policy.sample_selection: exact accessions and roles must be frozen from methods/sample metadata before any expression value is opened
replicate_policy.excess_eligible_preparations: selection rule must be frozen in the reviewed inclusion manifest before access; outcome values cannot select preparations

phenotype.name: workflow_detection_v1
phenotype.intermediate_rule: Illumina support exactly 1 of 2 or direct-RNA support 1 or 2 of 4

model_policy.required_preaccess_action: fit exactly one full-cohort StandardScaler plus multinomial LogisticRegression artifact from the frozen development matrix, then serialize and hash it before LongBench access

validation_preprocessing.independent_abundance_transform: log1p of TPM from the separately reserved eligible bulk Illumina preparation
validation_preprocessing.sequence_and_annotation_features: deterministic values for the pinned reference using the frozen development definitions
validation_preprocessing.standardization: apply the scaler fit on development only

metrics.primary: unweighted mean across eligible cell lines of five-class macro-F1 with zero_division=0
metrics.uncertainty: 10000-replicate percentile bootstrap resampling eligible cell lines with replacement
secondary: cell-line-specific and aggregate multiclass log loss
cell-line-specific and aggregate multiclass Brier score
per-class precision, recall, F1, and support
phenotype class prevalence by cell line
metrics.calibration: For every class, report counts, mean predicted probability, and observed proportion in 10 fixed equal-width probability bins; report no recalibrated predictions.
metrics.performance_success_threshold: NONE; report the prespecified estimate and uncertainty without a post hoc validated/not-validated cutoff

failure_conditions: absence of matched bulk Illumina and bulk ONT direct-RNA preparations in any included cell line
failure to identify exactly 2 Illumina outcome, 4 direct-RNA outcome, and 1 non-overlapping Illumina abundance preparation per included cell line
technical runs cannot be nested under biological preparations
annotation, transcript version, quantifier, or processing compatibility cannot be established before values are opened
any frozen transcript is missing, duplicated, ambiguously mapped, non-finite, or lacks a required feature or quantification row
feature-only access cannot be separated operationally from label/outcome access
serialized full-development estimator and preprocessing state are not frozen and hashed before LongBench access
prediction artifact is not saved and hashed before outcome-label exposure
any validation outcome or expression value influences inclusion, preprocessing, missingness handling, threshold, or model choice
any attempt is made to reinterpret LongBench as validation or rescue of Model D

steps: freeze study/sample inclusion, transcript mapping, code, environment, and the full-development estimator
obtain explicit human feature-only data-access authorization
materialize only reference features and the separately reserved independent-abundance covariate
generate class predictions and probabilities without opening outcome-library expression values
save and hash predictions plus inclusion and feature receipts
obtain separate explicit human label-access/scoring authorization tied to the prediction hash
construct workflow_detection_v1 labels from outcome preparations and score once
prediction_before_scoring.bundled_data_rule: If packaging exposes outcome-library values while constructing features, use a trusted custodian/sample-separated extraction; otherwise analysis is blocked.
